name: M1 Kliniken AG
summary: M1 Kliniken AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides aesthetic medicine and plastic surgery services in Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Croatia, Hungary, Bulgaria, and Romania. It operates through Beauty and Trade segments. The Beauty segment provides aesthetic surgery services, such as breast augmentation, eyelid lifts, and liposuction; and other aesthetic medical treatment services, including injections with hyaluronic acid and botulinum toxin. This segment also manages a private clinic for plastic and aesthetic surgery; and medical specialist centers for aesthetic and plastic medicine under the Schlossklinik and M1 Med Beauty names.
